title: Self-hosted Cloud Agents
description: March 25, 2026 release adds support for self-hosted cloud agents that keep your code and tool execution entirely in your own network. Your codebase, build outputs, and secrets all stay on internal machines running in your infrastructure, while the agent handles tool calls locally. Self-hosted cloud agents offer the same capabilities as Cursor-hosted cloud agents, including isolated VMs, full development environments, multi-model harnesses, plugins, and more.

title: Version 0.35.0 - Customizable Keyboard Shortcuts and Enhanced Vim Mode
description: March 24, 2026 release adds customizable keyboard shortcuts with support for literal character keybindings and extended Kitty protocol. Enhanced Vim mode with missing motions (X, ~, r, f/F/t/T) and yank/paste support. Introduced tool isolation and sandboxing with SandboxManager for Linux bubblewrap/seccomp sandboxing. Implemented JIT context discovery for file system tools to improve model performance.

title: Computer Use Research Preview in Claude Code
description: March 23, 2026 release adds computer use capabilities to Claude Code and Cowork, allowing Claude to interact with your computer system including browser automation and local file operations. Available to Pro and Max plan subscribers. Also includes Dispatch improvements for task management.

community_feedback.quote: Claude Code is still an amazing, if not the best way to write code. Adding these computer use tools into Claude Code makes it an even more compelling product
If we get reliable computer use models in 2026 or 2027, I probably won't ever hire anybody
The problem is that AI creates technical debt faster than we can pay it off
I use Supabase, PostgreSQL, n8n, and Claude Code every day to build and ship production systems
2026 is where it gets very real because of Claude Code. Developers using 4-10 terminals simultaneously

title: Copilot Coding Agent 50% Faster Startup
description: March 19, 2026 release improves Copilot coding agent startup performance by 50%, allowing developers to begin work more quickly. Performance optimization applies to agent initialization and task preparation workflows across all supported IDEs.

title: Version 1.9577.43 - Quota Billing System
description: March 19, 2026 release introduces a new quota billing system for Windsurf usage tracking and management. Users can now monitor and manage their API quota consumption more effectively with improved billing controls and visibility.

title: GPT-5.4 Mini Now Available
description: March 17, 2026 release adds support for OpenAI's GPT-5.4 Mini model in Windsurf. The new model offers improved performance and efficiency for code completion and generation tasks.

title: Version 0.34.0 - Plan Mode Enabled by Default
description: March 17, 2026 release enables Plan Mode by default to help break down complex tasks and execute them systematically. Added native gVisor (runsc) and experimental LXC container sandboxing support for safer execution environments.

title: Updates to GitHub Copilot for Students
description: March 13, 2026 release brings new features and improvements to GitHub Copilot for student developers. Update includes enhanced onboarding, better educational resource integration, and improved support for learning workflows.

title: Version 1.9577.27 - Fix for Apple M5
description: March 12, 2026 release fixes compatibility issues with Apple M5 processors. Resolves crashes and performance issues that affected users on the latest Apple silicon architecture.

title: Main Branch - Latest Model Support
description: Main branch updates include added support for Claude 4.5/4.6 models and updated model aliases, expanded Gemini model support with 2.5 Flash and Flash-Lite, added Gemini 3 preview models, DeepSeek Reasoner model support, and settings for new OpenAI GPT-5.1/5.2 and GPT-5-pro models across OpenAI, Azure, and OpenRouter.

title: Version 1.3.33 - Claude Sonnet and Opus 4.6 Updates
description: Latest release adds Claude Sonnet and Opus 4.6 model updates, integrates AI SDK provider, adds bash tool execution in background, turn-level prompt caching, PostHog metrics, live API tests, hooks system for CLI event interception, and 5 agent checks derived from codebase history. Includes multiple security upgrades and dependency updates.

title: Major Agentic Capabilities Improvements in GitHub Copilot for JetBrains IDEs
description: March 11, 2026 release brings significant improvements to agentic capabilities within GitHub Copilot for JetBrains IDEs. Enhanced multi-step reasoning, better context awareness, and improved task execution for complex development workflows in IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, and other JetBrains IDEs.
